findings.title: GitHub API calls do not retry transient failures
findings.summary: The automation makes direct API calls without a retry strategy, so transient failures can break the review flow and create noisy maintenance work.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap external API calls with explicit timeout handling and a small retry budget for transient failures.

findings.title: Issue creation labels are not validated consistently
findings.summary: Label input is accepted as free-form text, which can lead to malformed issue payloads or hard-to-debug workflow failures when spacing and empty entries are not normalized.
findings.recommended_fix: Normalize comma-separated labels before issue creation and fail with a clear API error if a requested label does not exist.
